report:
Dependency-only reconciliation of the frozen R4 contract/API (S27/S28) from CP r2 revision 3 to the current CP revision 4, returned as a small exact-text edit object for root to apply mechanically. No complete file bodies are supplied; every resulting full byte must receive fresh independent review, and no adoption occurs now. The earlier whole-document reconciliation that hit ~600s and exported zero candidate is superseded by this delta approach; no prior content was salvaged, and every edit is independently derived from the frozen S27/S28, S31/S32, S34 and S35.

Twelve edits in total (7 in the contract, 5 in the API, with the API condition block split into field-level replacements to keep spans small and unambiguous). They change only: (1) the exact CP source identities — root descriptor, byte+SHA pins (23830/03f03887 -> 30809/6e2c3989 contract; 5750/965b880d -> 8563/0f592eea API) and revision "3" -> "4" as the N01-N11 repair; (2) condition/status statements — "review in progress / may require changes / audit finishes" reconciled to "source-policy review complete, SOURCE_POLICY_READY, CP01-CP08 AGREE (CP04 and CP06 the changed literals), root-adopted only as the basis for separately reviewed test authoring"; (3) the CP API descriptor format bump to moriarty-c2-profile-r2-api/3 recorded in cpRevision only; (4) builderLabels.consumerProfile CP_R2_REV3... -> CP_R2_REV4...; (5) the limitations[3] literal; (6) the CP06 source-construction property now naming T02/T17 sampling with the T16 strictness caveat, consistently with rev4.

What is deliberately NOT changed: all twelve CB401-CB412 clause literals (no clause depends on the changed identity, so changedClauses is empty); R4's own c2-builder-r4-api/2 format; the dependency result format moriarty-c2-issue-artifacts/2; the 16 labels, 12 result keys, 11 C2I stages, 7 consumer/4 builder host APIs; rustAcceptance NOT_ESTABLISHED and every no-inference statement; the v1 prohibition; cpAdopted and every flag/authority false. No new implementation, policy, requirement or authority is introduced, no RED/GREEN/reliance/Rust-acceptance is claimed, and historical scoped proof is not relabelled as current universal correspondence. R4 remains CONDITIONAL pending a reviewed r2 implementation, a fresh non-author audit, meaningful RED then GREEN, a reviewed downstream contract, the separate CP08 decision and fresh votes on CB401-CB412.

limitations: Read-only, text-only. Nothing was executed, imported, compiled or hashed. All byte counts and SHA-256 values are taken as declared in MANIFEST.json and POLICY-ADOPTION.json (root-revalidated), not recomputed by me.

These are proposed mechanical edits, not applied. Root must independently assert each expectedOccurrences count against the frozen S27/S28, reconstruct the resulting full bytes, and compare every unchanged span before any use.

Every resulting full byte requires fresh independent review; no adoption occurs now. R4 remains CONDITIONAL pending a reviewed r2 implementation, a fresh non-author audit, meaningful RED then GREEN, a reviewed downstream contract, the separate CP08 r2 reliance decision, and fresh non-author votes on all of CB401-CB412.
changedClauses is empty: no CB401-CB412 clause literal depends on the changed CP identity/status, so all twelve clause bodies are preserved byte-for-byte.

Revision 4 has no clean VAL candidate directory in the frozen packet (it was delivered via the resume packet and the POLICY-ADOPTION record). I therefore pin it by exact bytes+SHA-256 and by the root manifest / POLICY-ADOPTION.json, and retain the revision-3 root only as the repaired-from history; I did not invent a revision-4 path.

R4's own API format c2-builder-r4-api/2 is preserved because no consumed literal (format /2, 12 keys, 16 labels, 11 stages, host APIs) changed between CP revision 3 and 4. The CP API descriptor format bump to moriarty-c2-profile-r2-api/3 is recorded only inside condition.cpRevision and is not relied upon by any R4 check.

Status statements are reconciled only to 'source-policy review complete / policy adopted for test authoring only'. I did not claim adoption of the r2 implementation, test execution, runtime results, GREEN, builder reliance, or any Rust-acceptance / subset / equivalence / conditional-inclusion relation; all such statements and all flags/authorities stay false.

The CP06 source-construction property wording now names T02/T17 sampling with the T16-strictness caveat to match revision 4; this is a consistency reconciliation of an existing statement, not a new requirement, and historical scoped proof is not relabelled as current universal correspondence.

Preserved unchanged: the 16 consumerLabels, 12 result keys, format /2, 11 C2I stages, 7 consumer and 4 builder host APIs, the v1 (23c3f99d...) prohibition and non-import, CB r1 non-routing, all 33 manifest keys / 9 builderLabels / 4 limitations / 10 flags counts, and every history item including the earlier R4 candidate supersession record and the prior failed exit-124 / 600s reconciliation attempt.
I did not read every packet file; I used MANIFEST, S27, S28, S31, S32, S34 and S35 as instructed, with S29/other files available only for crosscheck. Original private host paths were not followed.
